raw_blocks: Your Challenges, Our Engineered Solutions
HEICO Corporation (NYSE: HEI and HEI.A) established in 1957, is a dynamic and expanding technology-driven company specializing in aerospace, industrial, defense, and electronics sectors.

Flourishing through a commitment to innovation and cost-effective solutions, HEICO’s products are integral components on large commercial, regional, business, and military aircraft, as well as diverse applications like industrial turbines, targeting systems, missiles, and electro-optical devices.

Operating in two distinct segments, the Flight Support Group and the Electronic Technologies Group, HEICO Corporation remains at the forefront of technological advancements, providing essential solutions across multiple industries.

HEICO’s Flight Support Group is a globally recognized leader in aerospace aftermarket solutions, specializing in FAA-PMA parts, DER repairs, and aircraft component manufacturing. We design and manufacture cost-effective aircraft replacement parts, perform proprietary Designated Engineering Representative (DER) repairs and overhauls, and provide specialty product manufacturing and distribution services.

Trusted by major airlines, OEMs, and the U.S. military, HEICO supplies critical aircraft components and aerospace systems. We also manufacture products for many of the world’s leading aerospace and defense original equipment manufacturers. Our collaborative partnerships with global carriers drive the development of FAA-approved parts and aerospace aftermarket innovations that enhance operational efficiency and reduce maintenance costs.
HEICO Parts Group (HPG) is the world’s largest independent supplier of FAA-PMA approved engine and aircraft component parts, with a portfolio spanning nearly every engine platform and ATA chapter.

Backed by over 19,500 FAA approvals and producing more than 500 new highly engineered parts annually, HPG is more than a parts provider—it’s a leader in aircraft component manufacturing and aerospace aftermarket innovation.
Learn more / Access Customer Login

HEICO Repair Group (HRG) is positioned as the leading independent provider of flight-critical repair and overhaul services, specializing in over 32,000 aircraft accessory components. This includes Hydraulic, Electro-mechanical, Pneumatic, Avionic, Electronic, Power Generation and Structural aircraft sections.

As the preeminent global provider of independent Component Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul (MRO) and Asset Management Services, HRG’s success is credited to the exceptional capabilities of its team in thoroughly comprehending customer requirements and delivering customized solutions precisely tailored to meet their needs. We offer advanced repair solutions, including the development of over 700 FAA-DER repairs annually.
HEICO Distribution Group (HDG) is a leading distributor of FAA-approved parts and OEM replacement components for both commercial and military aircraft.

Supporting global airlines, MROs, and defense systems, HDG operates through a strategic network of offices and stocking facilities the Americas, Europe, Middle East, Asia, and Australia. With tailored fulfillment programs, on-site support, and long-term agreements, HDG delivers comprehensive solutions in the aerospace aftermarket and aircraft parts distribution space.

HEICO’s Electronic Technologies Group designs and manufactures high-reliability subcomponents and subsystems for aerospace, defense systems, avionics, telecommunications, medical, and industrial applications. These mission-critical components support aircraft systems, military aircraft components, and advanced electronics with precision engineering and dependable performance.

raw_blocks: HEICO Corporation (NYSE: HEI and HEI.A) is a successful and growing technology-driven aerospace, industrial, defense and electronics company. Since 1957, HEICO has thrived by providing customers with innovative and cost-saving products and services.

HEICO’s products are found on large commercial aircraft, regional, business and military aircraft, as well as on a large variety of industrial turbines, targeting systems, missiles and electro-optical devices.
HEICO Corporation operates in two segments, the Flight Support Group and the Electronic Technologies Group.
HEICO’s Flight Support Group is known globally as the premier provider of high-quality and cost-saving aftermarket parts supply and repair solutions.

These solutions include new parts design and manufacturing, proprietary Designated Engineering Representative (“DER”) repairs & overhauls, distribution and specialty product manufacturing. All major airlines are HEICO Flight Support Group customers. Our growing business also distributes non-HEICO-made parts, in addition to supplying critical components to original equipment manufacturers and the U.S. military. We are partnered with numerous airlines through innovative parts development arrangements.

HEICO’s Electronic Technologies Group is a trailblazer in the design, manufacture and sale of electrically and electro-optical engineered products used in the aerospace, defense, space, and electronics industries. Examples of the Electronic Technologies Group’s specialized products include hybrid DC-to-DC Converters, Microwave Latching Ferrite Switches, High Voltage Cable Assemblies & Connectors, Infrared Cameras, Laser Rangefinder Receivers, Memory Modules, Digital Recorders, Harsh Environment Connectors, Power Supplies, Amplifiers, Shielding and numerous other specialty items.

While most of our products are found in things that fly — like airplanes, satellites and missiles — we also supply many products to medical, electronics and non-flight defense systems. HEICO’s Electronic Technologies Group is “making the things that make things work.”

By combining state-of-the-art technologies, a team of highly skilled Team Members and an indisputable commitment to quality, both segments have constantly delivered invaluable solutions to customers over the years, helping to position them as leaders within their industries.
HEICO formed as Heinicke Instruments
The company changes its name to HEICO Corporation
The Board of Directors and management are reconstituted
Lufthansa Technik invests in 20% of HEICO’s Flight Support Group
HEICO Aerospace enters the Aircraft Accessory Component Repair & Overhaul business
HEICO Corporation’s shares are listed on the New York Stock Exchange
HEICO Flight Support Group forms an innovative subsidiary with American Airlines, to develop aircraft parts.
Many more partnerships are formed with major airlines in the years that follow
HEICO successfully enters aircraft parts distribution business with Seal Dynamics acquisition
HEICO surpasses $1 Billion in sales
HEICO is named one of the Best Small Companies by Forbes Magazine for the seventh time
Forbes World’s Most Innovative Growth Companies for the second time
HEICO completes 7 new acquisitions
HEICO raises and pays 77 th consecutive cash dividend since 1979
Forbes Most Trustworthy Companies in America

HEICO completes 7 acquisitions in 12 months
Market cap passes $16 Billion
HEICO Celebrates its 65th Anniversary
HEICO completes acquisition of Wencor Group

raw_blocks: HEICO’s Specialty Products Group (SPG) is a strategically aligned collection of subsidiaries that deliver highly engineered, mission-critical solutions across the aerospace, defense, and industrial sectors. This group specializes in complex manufacturing, precision machining, composite and metallic structures, thermal insulation systems, and advanced sealing technologies.

SPG ccompanies are known for their agility, innovation, and ability to support challenging customer requirements through custom-engineered products, build-to-print manufacturing, and rapid prototyping. With deep technical expertise and a strong commitment to quality and performance, the Specialty Products Group plays a critical role in advancing HEICO’s ability to serve OEMs, military contractors, and commercial aviation customers worldwide.

Accurate delivers precision aerospace component manufacturing with a wide range of value-added services, including AFM, electropolishing, electro-chemical deburring, clean-room assembly, and vibration deburring—supporting both FAA-approved parts and high-spec applications.

Aeroworks manufactures high-quality aircraft components, serving the aviation industry with precision engineering. Their parts are also utilized in trains, yachts, and medical systems, reflecting a broad scope of advanced manufacturing capabilities.
Astroseal’s Astrostrike® nonwoven metallic mesh provides lightning protection and EMI shielding for composite aircraft and aerospace systems, enhancing safety and durability.
Capewell engineers and manufactures advanced aerospace and defense solutions, including aerial delivery equipment and emergency descent devices for military and commercial aviation worldwide.
Specializing in unmanned systems, spacecraft structures, ablatives, and advanced composites, Carbon by Design supports cutting-edge aerospace and defense missions.
Decavo is a leader in composite engineering and aerospace manufacturing, offering full-spectrum services from concept through production for aircraft and defense structures.
JETSEAL develops high-performance resilient metal seals for extreme aerospace environments, supporting aircraft components with proven sealing technology.
Reinhold designs and manufactures lightweight, corrosion-resistant structural composite components for aircraft interiors, defense platforms, and space applications.
Ridge provides aerospace precision machining, including 5-axis CNC milling, vacuum brazing, and laser cutting for complex aircraft parts and assemblies.
Bechdon offers full-service aerospace machining and structural assembly, including CAD/CAM programming and mechanical inspection, backed by a trusted supplier network for coatings and treatments.
TEP engineers and fabricates removable and reusable insulation systems tailored for aerospace thermal management and high-performance industrial applications.
Thermal Structures delivers innovative insulation and composite solutions for aerospace systems, trusted for their performance and backed by industry-leading customer support.
